description: The doc comment on unknown_capability_with_detail contains 'Use this in preference to [unknown_capability()][Self::unknown_capability]'. Linking to a deprecated item in rustdoc can produce a 'deprecated in use' warning depending on rustdoc version and lint settings. If RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings is in CI this will break the doc build. The link should either be removed now that the function is deprecated, or a #[doc(hidden)] or explicit allow should suppress the lint.
notes: Verified: RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings cargo doc --no-deps -p jmap-types completes without warnings. Current rustdoc does not lint links to deprecated items. Finding stands as a future-proofing concern only.
title: intra-doc link to deprecated fn may trigger rustdoc lint in unknown_capability_with_detail doc
